name: Mux
soft_passes: #2 optical centring: bbox centres but visual mass is a diagonal lower-centre->upper-right sprawl with a thin left tail; deliberate wayfinding asymmetry, not grid-seated symmetry
#3 silhouette: 'forked/branching arrow' is nameable but abstract (a junction of termini, not a literal object)
#4 16px squint: strokes carry the gesture, but the up-right arrowhead (encodes 'switch') is the smallest AND lowest-contrast feature (#72B4FF ~luma 180 on white); thin left tail drops first
#10 variant robustness: glyph is self-coloured and survives tint/mono (menu-bar version proves it), but the blue ramp leans on a light/white base for legibility

palette.background: flat #FFFFFF (clear/light glass plate; reads pure white at 522px, full-res likely a faint cool ramp)
palette.accent: none (the blue glyph is itself the sole accent)

light_model: top-down, single source; baked specular highlight along the top edge of every glass rod, short soft drop shadow below (clearest under the T-foot terminal); consistent
layer_stack: blue extruded-glass fork glyph with baked specular + rounded rod terminals (front)
devices: diverging path / fork junction (curved left branch + vertical stem-to-T-foot + diagonal up-right arrow from one junction)
mismatched terminals as meaning: one outward arrowhead (switch/redirect) vs plain rounded T/foot caps (stay) — semantics carried by cap shape, not colour or badge
glass-rod extrusion with rounded line caps and top specular; left branch passes cleanly under the diagonal arrow
monochrome menu-bar template derivative (same glyph, single tint) confirmed in cover
rhymes_hint: single-glyph glass utility — one SF-Symbol-family directional glyph (arrow.triangle.branch / arrow.triangle.turn) as an extruded glass rod on a clear plate; kin to Apple system-utility and network/VPN menu-bar icons and transit/wayfinding-arrow marks
notes: Resolution caveat: source is 522x522, a web-resized render (not the 1024 master) — specular/ramp fine detail is softened and the background reads flat #FFFFFF; treat background as (estimated), full-res may carry a subtle cool-white ramp. Glyph appears to be a customised SF-Symbol-family branch/arrow. System Liquid-Glass specular is baked into this composite render (can't prove Icon Composer layering from the image), but the treatment is fully Liquid-Glass-consistent. Cover confirms brand palette is blue-forward and coherent with the icon, and shows the working mono menu-bar variant. First icon in the corpus — no peers to rhyme against yet; candidate seed for a 'single-glyph glass utility' icon cluster.
